svg.title: Which Fabric Workload Runs This Job?
svg.desc: A decision tree that starts by asking what kind of workload a job is: streaming events, batch/ELT ingestion and transformation, or interactive analytics and reporting. Streaming routes to Eventhouse via Real-Time Intelligence. Batch/ELT branches again on engine preference into Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks in Data Engineering, or SQL-first Warehouse/SQL Database. Interactive analytics routes to Power BI. All branches converge on OneLake, because every workload persists its tabular data as Delta Parquet there regardless of which engine wrote it, so the choice is about engine fit and skills, not data lock-in. A warning node flags picking a workload by team habit instead of the job's actual shape.

text.aria-label: Batch/ELT: which engine fits the team?

svg.text: Batch/ELT: which engine fits the team? — Second question for batch jobs: orchestration-heavy movement, Spark transformation, or T-SQL?Which Fabric engine? — a workload-selection decision map

Power BI (interactive consumption) — Interactive analytics and reporting reads from whatever upstream workload produced the data.Follow the shape of the job down through the gates. Every lane below still reads and writes the same Delta tables in OneLake.
